tagline: Monsters that follow the GM, Customize+ profiles and a sturdier lobby.

entries.headline: Monsters finally follow your moves for every player, MCDF files apply their Customize+ profile, and the lobby holds up much better with a crowd.

sections.title: Monsters and NPCs
items: A monster or NPC already on screen now follows the GM's moves for players, facing included.
A co-GM with no NPCs no longer makes the GM's NPCs disappear for players.
When several players arrive at once, the GM groups their updates: updates no longer get lost.

sections.title: Customize+
items: MCDF files now apply their Customize+ profile: the imported NPC keeps its proportions.
Customize+ stays optional: without it, the NPC appears without its proportions, and the GM is told at import.
MCDF files exported by recent plugins (BLAKE3 hashes) no longer lose their files at import.

sections.title: Lobby
items: A player coming back to the lobby is no longer kicked right away: this was causing the endless leave and rejoin loops.
Disbanding the in-game party no longer makes its members act as GMs: they keep receiving monsters, markers and weather.
Forming an in-game party no longer makes players leave and rejoin the lobby.
A co-GM leaving the lobby no longer closes it for everyone else.

sections.title: Notifications
items: Weather and time are only announced when they change.
One join or leave line per player every 30 seconds.
The version mismatch warning now shows only once.
